site.name: Bench Tools
site.tagline: Engineering calculators and simulators that run in your browser. Free, no account, offline once opened.

tools.name: Motion Bench
tools.blurb: Planar linkage and mechanism simulator. Draw links, pins, sliders, springs, dampers and cams, drive them, and get motion, joint forces, motor torque, bar diagrams and frequency response.

tools.name: Kinematics Bench
tools.blurb: Projectiles with air drag, ramps with friction, roller-coaster tracks you shape by hand, large-swing pendulums and collisions, with energy bookkeeping.

tools.name: Beam Bench
tools.blurb: Shear, moment, axial force and deflection diagrams for beams and 2D frames, determinate or indeterminate, with the hand calculation written out.

tools.name: Spring Bench
tools.blurb: Compression, extension and torsion spring design: rate, corrected stresses, solid height, buckling, surge and fatigue, with a pass/fail checklist and McMaster-Carr import.

tools.name: Solid Bench
tools.blurb: A basic 3D modeler: sketch, extrude, revolve, join and cut, with exact mass properties. Imports STL, 3MF and OBJ; exports STL.

tools.name: Thermo Bench
tools.blurb: Gas power cycles on P-v and T-s diagrams, a psychrometric chart, heat exchanger rating and sizing, and heater warm-up under thermostat or PI control.

tools.name: Magnet Bench
tools.blurb: Exact fields and flux lines of coils and magnets, the forces between them, electromagnets with saturation, eddy-current braking and skin depth.

tools.name: Amp Bench
tools.blurb: Plan an audio amplifier before buying parts: power and SPL, tube load lines, class AB and class D output stages, power supplies and output transformers.
